+// ΓöÇΓöÇ Web Search Integration ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ
+async function performSerperSearch(query: string): Promise<string> {
+  const serperApiKey = Deno.env.get('SERPER_API_KEY');
+  if (!serperApiKey) return '';
+
+  try {
+    const res = await fetch('https://google.serper.dev/search', {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers: {
+        'X-API-KEY': serperApiKey,
+        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
+      },
+      body: JSON.stringify({ q: query, num: 3 })
+    });
+    
+    if (!res.ok) return '';
+    const json = await res.json();
+    
+    const snippets = (json.organic || [])
+      .slice(0, 3)
+      .map((r: any, i: number) => `Snippet ${i+1}: "${r.title} - ${r.snippet}"`)
+      .join('\n');
+      
+    return snippets;
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.error('Serper search error:', e);
+    return '';
+  }
+}

+async function generateStructuredSkuWithContext(
+  supabaseClient: any,
+  openaiClient: any,
+  messyInput: string,
+  vendorCategory: string,

+  // 1. Fast preliminary match to identify a potential target subcategory

+  if (!initialHits) {

+  // GATING STRATEGY: Determine similarity ceiling to isolate structural orphans
+  const topHitSimilarity = initialHits && initialHits.length > 0 ? (initialHits[0].similarity ?? 0) : 0;

+  
+  // Only inject sibling context if the fast-pass hit is robust and meaningful (>= 0.40)
+  if (topHitSimilarity >= 0.40 && initialHits && initialHits.length > 0) {

+    // Pull verified sibling records for high-fidelity style mirroring
+    const { data: siblings } = await supabaseClient
